assistant_message.content:
**Do not select all.** For the manager call-and-inbox accountability system, select only these **read-only** permissions:

| Select | Why |
|---|---|
| **Leads** | New leads, stages, timestamps, and lead history. |
| **Lead notes** | Documented call outcomes and follow-up notes. |
| **Properties** | Building names, timezones, and property-level reporting. |
| **People** | Managers and freelance callers. |
| **Assignments** | Who is responsible for each property. |
| **Conversations** | Individual lead inbox threads and response timing. |
| **SMS** | Inbound text activity and unanswered messages. |
| **Timesheets** | Caller coverage context during work hours. |
| **Company** | Verifies the integration is connected to the correct organization. |
| **Audit log** | Shows who changed what and when. |
| **Contact details** *(scroll down)* | Phone, email, and message bodies; needed to connect call/inbox activity to the correct lead. |

Use the name **`Lead Command — Read-Only Accountability`**. Leave **Units, Photos and documents, Saved replies, Email campaigns, Lead sources**, and everything else unchecked. **Do not enable “Allow this key to make changes.”** Then click **Create key** and leave the one-time key screen open for me.

Also verify whether the server created any key despite the UI crash and revoke duplicates if present.

Once the owner confirms the fix—or sends the console/API error—we can complete the live call-and-inbox oversight integration.
